item.description:
Shared projects now open without downloading every file first. LeonardoMD and Little Leonardo synchronize the file and folder catalogue, then download a document and its referenced local images when you open it.
Use the contextual menu to keep files or folders offline. Retained folders include new files added later. Preferences shows temporary cache and offline storage separately: choose a temporary cache limit, apply it, or clear temporary files while preserving offline copies. The default temporary limit is 256 MiB; files kept offline do not count toward it.
If an update fails, a retained earlier copy stays readable with a clear warning, the download error and Retry. Referenced-image failures also remain visible. Spanish and English help explains the new controls and recovery behavior. Little Leonardo keeps document headings close to the navigation bar and lets you switch between the document and its read-only source without downloading it again.
This beta also includes the previously published connection and automatic rubric-status recovery fixes.
Known limits: automatic refresh runs while the receiving app is active, and transfers require a reachable source Mac. Older source services need updating to support on-demand downloads. Offline retention requires sufficient device storage. This macOS download supports Apple silicon. Little Leonardo distribution is managed separately through TestFlight.

## Clearer file selection and readable Leonardo filenames
The active file stays highlighted in the project explorer, including MDLF, MDLR and MDLZ, even when automatic following is turned off. Selection uses the system highlight with readable text and icons.
Leonardo filenames retain their wine color in light appearance and use a brighter tint in dark appearance. The English and Spanish guides explain selection and automatic following separately; existing personal guide copies remain intact.
This beta is for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Candidate-specific installed update and relaunch acceptance remains pending.
